## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the trigger, change and user-visible result. Link the issue.

## Validation

- [ ] pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
- [ ] pnpm lint and pnpm typecheck
- [ ] pnpm test and pnpm check:secrets
- [ ] pnpm build
- [ ] pnpm test:integration where applicable
- [ ] Manual browser smoke test for changed user flows
- [ ] No secrets, raw datasets or personal database exports staged

List checks not run, blockers and remaining limitations. Do not mark planned ML features as implemented.
